settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_DARKVISITORS_TOKEN
settings.description: Bearer token for the DarkVisitors API.

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_DARKVISITORS_AGENT_TYPES
settings.description: Comma-separated list of agent types (e.g., `AI Data Scraper`) to include from DarkVisitors.

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_DARKVISITORS_DISALLOW
settings.description: A string specifying which URLs are disallowed. This value will be sent as the disallow field when contacting the DarkVisitors API.

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_COMMUNITY_LISTS
settings.description: Space-separated list of community-maintained rule set IDs to include.

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_URLS
settings.description: Space-separated list of URLs to fetch additional `robots.txt` rules from. Supports `file://` and basic auth (`http://user:pass@url`).

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_HEADER
settings.description: Header for `robots.txt` file (before rules). Can be Base64 encoded.

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_FOOTER
settings.description: Footer for `robots.txt` file (after rules). Can be Base64 encoded.

settings.name: ROBOTSTXT_IGNORE_RULE
settings.description: A single PCRE regex pattern to ignore rules.
